name: cmux.composer.mention/1
docs: A mention provider for the agent chat composer: items the person names with @. The daemon answers completions (apps.composer.mentions {query}) from the manifest's items, ranked in Rust; picking one writes its insert text.

prefix.description: The word that narrows @ to this provider (@ticket:).

label.description: What the row shows and what a query matches.

insert.description: The text written for the mention; the label when absent.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
